notes.title: Suits MV Update (03/29/20)
notes.content:
A lot of players have encountered a strange bug once they reached the Factory Fields and encountered a random battle the game would just get stuck on a loading screen. When this was first reported, I wasn't able to replicate it. Eventually I managed to encounter the same problem, but with no way of fixing it. After a member of our discord reached out to us about this issue I explained that there seemed to be no fix. I decided to give it another go and I wasn't encountering this issue anymore. However this happened before where the game was working fine, but once I made a build the same problem would occur. Except this time it actually worked. I'm guessing this new version of RPG Maker MV fixed something. Not only that but now I was able to make a proper Linux and Mac port of Suits via RPG Maker MV rather than the weird hack I had to do.

Please let me know if these versions are working.

Also Achievements only work on the non-MV version of Suits.

[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/H5MjkM9]Discord[/url]

-MAL_Ware

notes.title: Development Update 04/05/18
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's been now 2 years since Suits was released and we have very busy working on a few new titles. After Suits we started working on our now canceled game Zoopocalypse. We felt that Zoopocalypse was just a bad game and it was a bit more than we can chew. We spent almost a year working on it, and just felt it wasn't going anywhere. However, I personally wouldn't consider it a waste of time for we as a team gained the knowledge to make a much better game. This game is Gamma 19, an Action Adventure RPG ( https://technomancystudios.itch.io/gamma-19 ). We have been working on this a little over a year now and still have more to do. I can say that we are half way done with it. We plan to do a kickstarter once we are near completion, just to help us fund proper ports(Switch port hopefuly) and localization. We are also working on a much smaller game right now since we are taking a small break from Gamma 19. This game is close to been done we just need to finish art and music. This game will be $0.99 while Gamma 19 will be $4.99. After Gamma 19 we will be working on Suits 2. We already planned the game out, but we might have to go back and reorganize and finialize our thoughts so that Suits 2 can be the best it can be. We want Suits 2 to allow new players to understand the overall story without playing Suits 1, for we don't want anyone to go through the trouble of playing Suits 1(It's not that good). I felt like I needed to make this update to inform you guys about our current situation and our future as developers. We are always working on new games, and we hope that the success of Gamma 19 will be more than enought for us to grow and make more games. If you want to stay updated the best way would be to follow us on Twitter and Tumblr. 

Stay frosty,
-MAL_Ware ːmarkjudyː

Twitter: https://twitter.com/TechnomancyUS
Tumblr: https://technomancystudios.tumblr.com/

notes.title: A small patch and a quick FAQ!
notes.content:
So first I'm going to start with the patch notes then I'll get to the FAQ.

Patch 01/10/16
-Fixed a few spelling problems.
-Made it so if you lose to GOGO Runny Man you are kicked out of the painting.
-Fixed the "Change of Plans" Achievement.
-Fixed the Leader from disappearing when you talk to him
-Fixed some battle sprites.
-Pressing the F12 button still takes you back to the main menu. This cannot be fixed due to RPG Maker having this function built in. There are scripts to disable it, but they never work.

Before I get started on the FAQ we want to thank everyone who bought and played our game. We honestly didn't expect this game to do this well. We had gone through a lot during the development of Suits. The original idea of Suits was completely different from what Suits is now. We made huge last minute changes during development, like changing and adding enemies. We planned on finishing Suits two months into development, but I slacked off and didn't feel motivated to work. It didn't help that Undertale came out during the development of Suits. Once we saw it we knew that we couldn't do better, but it didn't matter because Suits is our creation. We were talking about whether Suits was a success. We all had different responses. I said yes due to the number of sales and the ratings. The artist(Urban Jesus) said something along the same lines. Proto(Musician) said that once people begin to defend our game for us that is when we know that we succeeded. Suits is the first step we needed to take to reach our goal. I want to thank you all again for supporting us. We really appericate the positive and negative feed back because that is just how we learn to get better. We never try to defend any mistakes that we make because it would only do more harm to us than good. Anyway lets get started on the FAQ.

Q: Was this game inspired by OFF?
A: Yes.

Q: Were the sprites drawn on paper and scanned in?
A: No that would take too much time to do. We drew all of the sprites on GIMP with a tablet.

Q: Will there be a sequel?
A: If you beat the game you will find out.

If you guys have anymore questions I will try to answer them.
We can't thank you guys enough for supporting us. If you wish to support and follow us you can check out our facebook, youtube, and twitter.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/technomancyUS/
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCd4QOkz1qDPp42qNW0Ni7AA
Twitter: @TechnomancyUS

Papa bless
                -MAL_Ware ːmarkjudyː
